data.heading: MRAM Earnings Date

text: MRAM has a "high" Earnings Quality Ranking (EQR) for the 12th consecutive week. Earnings quality refers to the extent to which current earnings predict future earnings. "High-quality" earnings are expected to persist, while "low-quality" earnings do not. EQR is a weekly ranking of relative earnings quality for a large universe of publicly traded US equities. Companies are compared to peers in their industry. Find out more about EQR data.
